name: oracles-supp-quant-v1
note: Hand-authored 2026-09-30 for the supp-quant partition (dataset/supp-quant.json) from each scenario's own source (question, prior transcript, attached file), never from any answer. Values computed by hand; every check was self-tested against one correct and at least one plausibly wrong spoken-style answer. Checks run on the whole displayed text (answer body + GIST chip) after validators/numbers.mjs normalisation, so patterns use digits. Discrepancy items require a reconciling figure OR an explicit mismatch statement; consistent-dispute items forbid claiming the charge is wrong. number_absent values are derived wrong results that a correct answer has no reason to state; figures that appear in the question are never number_absent.

SQGEN-001.expected_summary: Shared costs: tickets 94 (friend) + parking 18 + lunch 62.40 + cab 31 (user) = 205.40; the 11 ice cream is excluded (friend said it was just hers). Half = 102.70. Friend paid 94, so the FRIEND owes the USER 102.70 - 94 = 8.70 (user paid 111.40, 8.70 over half). Traps: counting the ice cream (216.40/2 = 108.20 - 105 = 3.20); paying the unhalved gap 111.40 - 94 = 17.40; reversing the direction.

checks.label: direction reversed (user paying the friend)

SQGEN-002.expected_summary: Flat rate per person per night: person-nights = 4 (user) + 4 (friend) + 2 (Rafa) = 10; 720 / 10 = 72. User owes 4 x 72 = 288; Rafa owes 2 x 72 = 144 (friend covers her own 288; 288 + 144 + 288 = 720). Traps: even split 240 each; per-night split among those present (user 300, Rafa 120), which contradicts the agreed flat rate.

SQGEN-003.expected_summary: Total 264 + 96 + 48 + 24 = 432 over 4 payers (Maren excluded) = 108 each. Net: Theo +156, Priya -12, user -36, Jonah -108. Fewest transfers (3): Jonah -> Theo 108, user -> Theo 36, Priya -> Theo 12. Traps: splitting five ways (86.40 each), three ways (144), or Theo paying the user.

SQGEN-004.expected_summary: Sequential discounts do not add: 240 x 0.80 = 192, then 192 x 0.85 = 163.20 (effective 32% off), not 156. The 156 is stated in the question and a correct answer may echo it, so it is not number_absent; the required 163.20 carries the item.
